name: Thornscrub Thresher

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The thresher makes two Tusk attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Opportunist's Lash.

Actions.name: Tusk
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 19 (4d6 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the thresher moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Opportunist's Lash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Prone. *Failure:* 35 (10d6) Piercing damage. *Success:* Half damage.
Actions.gmQuote: charges in a straight line knocks everything flat and keeps going

Actions.name: Ground-Shaking Bellow (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 16, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.

Bonus Actions.name: Trample
Bonus Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Traits.name: Relentless Momentum
Traits.text: When the thresher is subjected to an effect that would reduce its Speed or knock it Prone, The thresher can choose to ignore the effect; if it does, it instead presses forward and can move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Traits.name: Sure Footing
Traits.text: Difficult Terrain composed of thorn, bramble, rubble, and standing water doesn't cost the thresher extra movement, and the thresher can move across thorn, bramble, rubble, and standing water without needing to make an ability check.
Traits.expresses: straight-line charge that knocks everything prone

lore: Born in the thornscrub flats where game trails run long and straight, the thresher-beast has learned that anything it can line up is on its account, and it wants a clear path wherever it walks.

generation.userConcept: a thresher-beast that charges in a straight line, knocks everything flat, and keeps going
generation.cite: composition after Gorgon (CR 5) — charge plus a breath-shaped nova
